cleared.check: Task 4, MegaETH. Whether an instruction handler of mega-evm is specialised by operand value, gas level or call depth, read at tag v1.7.4. The endpoint reported mega-reth/v2.3.1-4499c42 before and after every batch; mega-reth is closed, and megaeth-labs/stateless-validator on main pins mega-evm tag v1.7.4. Tags v1.7.5, v1.7.6, v1.8.0, v1.8.1 and v2.0.0 returned 404.
cleared.result: In v1.7.4 every arithmetic, shift, byte and comparison opcode of every spec table is a compute_gas_ext wrapper (instructions.rs:862-889) made by wrap_op_compute_gas (instructions.rs:3019-3045, 3113-3124): it reads the gas left, calls revm's own handler unchanged, and records static gas plus the gas the handler used against MegaETH's compute-gas limit. The pushed value is revm's. revm-interpreter 37.0.3 (Cargo.lock) computes MULMOD, ADDMOD, SDIV, SMOD, SIGNEXTEND, SAR, SHL, SHR and BYTE with no branch on literal operands, depth or gas beyond the EVM rules (arithmetic.rs:31-137, bitwise.rs:107-158); ruint is 1.19.0, before the faulty 1.21.0. The only gas-level effect is a halt when the compute-gas limit is exceeded, which ends the frame and changes no word. A producer that differs from its replica on an edge would need a closed patch to these handlers. The public stateless validator recomputes each block's state root with mega-evm (cleared in cycle 19), so such a patch would show as a failed validation on the first block whose transaction met that edge.

leadResults.answer: 47 of the 774 sides were run by nothing. 22 are math sides and every one is unreachable by a bound an earlier line enforces (out/table.json and the first cleared entry). The math sides that only one set had run are SqrtPriceMath.sol:105 (cycle 25 only), rerun as 7 liquidity variants that return the reference words on all 21 networks and revert at the int128 casts of Pool.sol:455-459, and Pool.sol:197, 200 and 206, which all four producers have mined.

Counts per site and edge are in out/edges.json. MegaETH and HyperEVM mined frames used SAR by 255 and SIGNEXTEND of negative ticks, SDIV and SMOD of negative inexact compressed ticks, the round-up mulmod with zero and nonzero remainders, and mulmod by not(0) with a nonzero high word in one of five compiled copies of mulDiv. Of 208 site and edge pairs no mined frame of those two used, 205 are run by reference cases that every network's eth_call answered with the reference words; 3 borrowing subtractions in getFeeGrowthInside remain (new lead). mega-evm v1.7.4 and nanoreth nb-20261125-2 specialise no arithmetic handler by operand, gas level or depth.
